title: Homo Fluxus v2.0 — A Civilization Map Through Energy-Flow Cosmology: From Grid to Governance — One Gradient, All Regimes
abstract: Homo Fluxus defines the human as a dynamic gradient system embedded in the same entropy-flow dynamics that govern the cosmos. The EFC chain Grid->EF->S->D->C is applied across biology, cognition, economy, energy, governance, and AI. v2.0 adds empirical anchor: degree ratio determines functional variability in the human brain (r~-0.97).
